name: biomodels-cross-simulator-validation
title: Cross-simulator validation of BioModels
question: Do independent SBML simulators reproduce curated BioModels, and how well do they agree with each other and with the BioSimulators reference results?
hypothesis: For well-posed BioModels, COPASI, Tellurium and simbio agree with the BioSimulators references within a small nRMSE; divergences localize to stiff or ill-scaled models and expose engine-specific tolerance sensitivity.

executive.what_is_this: A process-bigraph workspace that loads BioModels, runs them under multiple simulators (and the BioSimulators SED-ML references), and scores agreement. Both the interactive report and the zarr results archive are outputs of the batch-compare-biomodels composite.
executive.verdict: Live engines and references agree on the curated set within the "good" nRMSE bucket for most observables; see the study for the per-model matrix.
